physicalNotes: Radius 0.547 +/- 0.025 solar radii from Mallorquín et al. 2023, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of TOI-1801 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023A&A...680A..76M/abstract): 380,548 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.556 +/- 0.042 solar masses from Mallorquín et al. 2023, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of TOI-1801 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023A&A...680A..76M/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 3863 +/- 77 K from Mallorquín et al. 2023, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-1801 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023A&A...680A..76M/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
